purpose: Scores nearby 3D adornees for contextual hints using distance, view angle, screen visibility, bounding-box proximity, and optional line of sight.
description: Finds and ranks nearby hint targets relative to a humanoid and the current camera.

HintScoringUtils.luau.description: Finds adornees near a position and scores their suitability as contextual hint targets using distance, view angle, screen visibility, bounding boxes, and raycast line of sight. Public entry points include `HintScoringUtils.getHumanoidPositionDirection`, `HintScoringUtils.getAdorneeInRegionSet`, `HintScoringUtils.debugScore`, `HintScoringUtils.raycastToAdornee`, `HintScoringUtils.clampToBoundingBox`, `HintScoringUtils.scoreAdornee`, `HintScoringUtils.scoreDist`, `HintScoringUtils.scoreAngle`.
